Utility Programs

Command line tools for checking and repairing DataReel database files.

Contents

Tools

Tools

  • objrepl (7.4): object replication between Windows and Linux nodes from the command line (copy, status, check, digest, takeover, rejoin), and its test data generator; see the administrator's guide.
  • db_debug: analyze, dump and rebuild gxDatabase files.
  • ix_debug: analyze and check gxBtree index files.
  • vix_rebuild (7.4): rebuild a vector index from the vector members of records; digests of vector indexes.
  • dr_digest (7.4): what a database, B-tree or file holds, as one 64-bit digest, whatever its layout (dr_digest FILE [--kind btree|bytes|objects]).
  • object_server and object_client: the database object server and its client, with vector searches (Linux and Windows).
  • hexdump (back in 7.4): a file in hex, decimal or as a C array, a binary file rebuilt from its hex dump, CRC-32 and CRC-16 checksums.
  • ffind (back in 7.4): find, replace and insert strings in text files, or replace a whole section.
  • txfilter (back in 7.4): keep the printable (or alphabetic, alphanumeric, numeric) characters of a text file; UNIX or DOS line ends.

They are built by CMake into cmake-build/utils and installed with the library.
